name: The Fate of Irnia
source:
Each 12 years orcs attack your homeland and each time it has enough forces only to defend but never to strike back.

Your father was a hero  of the last attack, who unfortunately passed away from an unknown disease on your 17th birthday.

He left you alone with your mother, your sister and a gift box that you can open only when you come of age.

That was one year ago...

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/winterlook]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
每12年，兽人都会攻击你的家园，每次它都有足够的军队来防守，但从不反击。

你的父亲是上次袭击中的英雄，在你17岁生日那天不幸因不明疾病去世。

他把你单独留给了你的母亲、你的妹妹和一个只有当你成年后才能打开的礼物盒。

那是一年前的事了…

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/winterlook]Patreon[/url]]
